title: lensurance
tagline: collect module for lens protocol which only allows a single collect per person.
description: collect module for lens protocol which only allows a single collect per person. this module can be used with any lens publication, allowing sybil-resistant use cases. we use worldcoin's zero-knowledge proofs to validate that the user is a real person and has not collected that publication before.
